bio.text: Chuck Fleischmann represents Tennessee's 3rd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and chairs the Appropriations Subcommittee on Energy and Water Development.
He earned an undergraduate degree in political science from the University of Illinois and a law degree from the University of Tennessee.
He and his wife ran a small business in Chattanooga for 24 years, and he has served as president of the Chattanooga Bar Association.
